## What does this PR add or change?

## Checklist

- [ ] The link returns HTTP 200 and points to the tool's canonical homepage, repo, or docs — **no tracking parameters** (`?ref=`, `?utm_=`, etc.)
- [ ] The tool is relevant to DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering **and has a clear AI/ML component**
- [ ] The project has real adoption (for open source: meaningful stars, forks, or an active community — very early personal projects are closed until they gain traction)
- [ ] The entry is placed in the correct category **in alphabetical order**
- [ ] The format matches `- [Name](https://link) - Description that ends with a period.`
- [ ] The description states what the tool does, not marketing copy
- [ ] The tool is not already in the list (search the README first — duplicates fail CI)
- [ ] I am not removing the trailing newline at the end of README.md

## Disclosure

- [ ] I am affiliated with this tool (author, employee, contributor) — *self-submissions are welcome when the project meets the quality bar; just tell us*
